name: PH-NODE
title: Healthcare Network Node
description: Ultra-compact network node for healthcare environments. View records, charts, x-rays, and MRI results at the bedside.
detailDescription: The PH-NODE is an ultra-compact network node designed for healthcare professionals to access patient records, charts, x-rays, and MRI results at the bedside. Features Gigabit Ethernet, VGA output, USB ports, and flash memory card support.

specifications.value: xD, Memory Stick, CF, MMC, SD

features: Network gateway for viewing medical records, charts, x-rays, MRI results
Gigabit Ethernet for fast reliable networking
VGA output to connect to TV for browsing
Multiple USB ports and flash card reader
High security with biometric lock support
Eco-friendly design with flame retardant housing
